description: Powerful Cleaning, Convenient Design: This 2100-watt Aquatak 140 high pressure washer offers powerful cleaning and convenient design for all your home and garden needs. It delivers a high-quality, powerful performance, making quick work of tough cleaning jobs. Practical storage solutions for cables and hoses keep everything organized, while its ability to draw water from both mains and external sources provides added flexibility. Telescopic Handle & BOSCH Gun: The BOSCH Advanced Aquatak 140 is designed for ease of use, featuring a telescopic handle for convenient maneuverability. The included high-pressure gun puts you in complete control, allowing adjustments to water flow and cleaning modes with a simple trigger. This combination makes cleaning tasks efficient and manageable. High Pressure Washer & Self-priming: Pressure washers use significantly less water than garden hoses, thanks to their 140-bar pressure, concentrated spray. This 0.5m self-priming pressure washer can draw water from an external source, offering greater flexibility. Enhanced Nozzle System: Includes a variable fan jet nozzle with a thicker body for improved grip, operation, handling, attachment, and storage. A rotary nozzle crafted from brass and ceramic for smoother operation and a sharper cleaning jet. It has a high-pressure foam nozzle with a 550ml detergent tank for quick and Advanced detergent application. Safe Operation with Fast Cleaning: The BOSCH Advanced Aquatak 140 is designed for water temperatures up to 40°C; using hotter water could cause damage. Wash a two-wheeler in just 5 minutes and a four-wheeler in only 10 minutes, making regular cleaning fast and convenient.
